quotes.quote: In the rostral LC, the median neuronal density was 34 neurons/mm 2 (interquartile range 22,44) in AD cases versus 60 neurons/mm 2 (50,89) in controls ( p < 0.001)
Similarly, in the middle LC, neuronal density was 38 neurons/mm 2 (27,57) in AD versus 79 neurons/mm 2 (46,104) in controls ( p < 0.001)
In the caudal LC, density was 42 neurons/mm 2 (29,56) in AD versus 83 neurons/mm 2 (49,98) in controls ( p = 0.015)
Anatomically, the PAG, a small, curved, hollow partial cylinder approximately 10–14 mm long and 4–5 mm in external diameter encircling the central aqueduct in the midbrain
